verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files (not a proprietary format lock-in), explicitly marketed as enabling users to 'switch to another app easily' and own their data forever, and community users confirm they value having 'ownership of my files' when leaving other apps (e.g., migrating from Roam). Import/export interoperability is reinforced by plugins converting from/to Notion, Evernote, etc. missing for 10: independent hands-on test of full vault export/round-trip to another app, and acknowledgment that newer Canvas files are JSON rather than Markdown (a partial open-format caveat noted by the community).
